supplementaryAuthorities.title: 106th Constitutional Amendment — commencement notification
supplementaryAuthorities.summary: The 106th Amendment Act, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam) came into force on 16 April 2026. Articles 330A, 332A and 334A (women's reservation framework) were inserted by this Amendment; operational implementation remains subject to census and delimitation.
